// Real CLI, driven directly: initialize, one user message, a streamed text reply from the fake, result, stdin closed.
import { drive, gatewayEnv, baseArgs, initRequest, userText, startFakeAnthropic, SCRATCH, brief } from "./real-drive.mjs";
import fs from "node:fs";

fs.mkdirSync(`${SCRATCH}/real`, { recursive: true });
const fake = await startFakeAnthropic({ script: () => ({ text: "Hello from the fake." }) });
try {
  const home = `${SCRATCH}/homes/basic`;
  const cwd = `${SCRATCH}/ws/basic`;
  const r = await drive({
    name: "01-basic",
    args: baseArgs(),
    env: gatewayEnv(home, fake.url),
    cwd,
    stdin: [
      initRequest({ systemPrompt: ["You are a test."], systemPromptSnapshot: false }),
      userText("say hi"),
    ],
  });
  console.log("exit", r.exitCode, r.signal, "at", r.exitAt, "ms; stderr:", JSON.stringify(r.stderr.slice(0, 500)));
  for (const o of r.stdout) console.log(o.t, o.msg ? brief(o.msg) : `RAW ${o.raw.slice(0, 200)}`);
  console.log("API requests:", fake.requests.map((q) => `${q.method} ${q.path}`).join(" | "));
  fs.writeFileSync(`${SCRATCH}/real/01-basic.api.json`, JSON.stringify(fake.requests, null, 2));
} finally {
  await fake.close();
}
